name: Two-colourings avoiding a red 3-term and a blue 12-term progression (w(3,12) = 135)
description: construct() -> colours c_1, ..., c_N in {0, 1} with 1 <= N <= 135. Colour 0 may contain no 3-term and colour 1 no 12-term arithmetic progression (exhaustive check). Maximize N; the optimum is 134 because w(3,12) = 135. Since w(3,12) = 135, the longest valid colouring has 134 terms; the task recovers an extremal colouring.
